title: OCI Generative AI Embedding Function Schema
description: Schema for the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI embedding function configuration

model_name.description: Identifier of the OCI Generative AI embedding model, e.g. cohere.embed-v4.0

compartment_id.description: OCID of the compartment used to call the OCI Generative AI service

service_endpoint.description: OCI Generative AI inference endpoint. Derived from the profile or principal region when omitted

auth_type.description: How to authenticate against OCI. Credentials themselves are never stored in the config

auth_profile.description: Profile name in the OCI config file (API_KEY and SECURITY_TOKEN auth types)

auth_file_location.description: Path of the OCI config file (API_KEY and SECURITY_TOKEN auth types)

truncate.description: How inputs longer than the model context are truncated

input_type.description: Input type forced for every request. When null, documents use SEARCH_DOCUMENT and queries use SEARCH_QUERY

output_dimensions.description: Requested embedding size for models that support it (e.g. 256, 512, 1024, 1536 for cohere.embed-v4.0)
